source.text: At least one measurable lesion based on RECIST (Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors) V1.1
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0 to 1
Documented locally advanced or metastatic HER2-expressing (IHC 1+ to 3+ and/or HER2 gene amplification or activating mutation
active or untreated CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis should be excluded
Participants who have a history of noninfectious interstitial lung disease (ILD)/ pneumonitis that required treatment with steroids, have current ILD/pneumonitis

Active autoimmune diseases and inflammatory diseases, such as systemic lupus erythematosus, psoriasis requiring systemic treatment, rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, and Hashimoto's thyroiditis, etc.
Participants with known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection (HIV antibody positive)
For Dose Expansion Only: Prior treatment with any topoisomerase inhibitor ADC
